# HealthyChildren.org

> > HealthyChildren.org is the American Academy of Pediatrics' trusted resource providing evidence-based parenting guidance, child development information, and pediatric health recommendations for families and caregivers.

HealthyChildren.org is the official parenting and child health resource from the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), reaching millions of parents and supporting 67,000 pediatricians. The site offers comprehensive guidance on child development, health conditions, safety, nutrition, and family wellness backed by AAP's clinical expertise.

## Key Topics

- American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP)
- Child development milestones
- Ages & Stages (infants, toddlers, preschool)
- Well-child visits and immunizations
- Infant care and SIDS prevention
- Pediatric health conditions (ADHD, Autism, COVID-19)
- Child safety and injury prevention
- Nutrition and healthy living
- Family wellness and parenting
- Developmental screening tools
- Symptom checker tools
- Pediatrics journal insights
- AAP clinical recommendations

## Child Development by Age

- [Prenatal - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/ages-stages/prenatal): Prenatal care, pregnancy health, and vaccination guidance for expectant parents
- [Baby - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/ages-stages/baby): Newborn and infant development guide with AAP well-child visit recommendations
- [Toddler - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/ages-stages/toddler): Toddler development milestones and parenting guidance for ages 1-3
- [Preschool - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/ages-stages/preschool): Preschool development guide covering ages 4-5 physical, social, and cognitive skills
- [Ages & Stages - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/ages-stages/pages/default.aspx): Child development guides covering infants, toddlers, and developmental milestones

## Health Issues & Medical Conditions

- [Health Issues - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/health-issues/pages/default.aspx): Directory of pediatric health conditions, illnesses, and medical issues
- [Safety & Prevention - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/safety-prevention): Child safety, immunizations, and disease prevention guidance from AAP

## Parenting & Family Wellness

- [Family Life - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/family-life/pages/default.aspx): Family relationships, parenting, and mental health resources for families
- [Healthy Living - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/healthy-living/pages/default.aspx): Nutrition, fitness, and wellness guides for children's healthy living

## Tools & Resources

- [Tips & Tools - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/tips-tools/pages/default.aspx): Interactive parenting tools including Family Media Plan and Asthma Action Tracker

## News & Updates

- [News - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/News/pages/default.aspx): AAP news highlights and pediatric health research updates from Pediatrics journal

## About & Mission

- [HealthyChildren.org - From the American Academy of Pediatrics](https://www.healthychildren.org/English/Pages/default.aspx): AAP's HealthyChildren.org homepage with parenting guides and pediatric health resources
- [About HealthyChildren.org - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/our-mission/pages/default.aspx): About HealthyChildren.org, the AAP-backed parenting resource for 67,000 pediatricians
- [Medical Editor & Contributors - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/our-mission/Pages/contributors.aspx): HealthyChildren.org editorial team and medical contributors information

## Optional

- [Sponsorship Opportunities - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/our-mission/pages/sponsorship-opportunities.aspx): AAP sponsorship and partnership opportunities for HealthyChildren.org
- [Spread the Word - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/our-mission/pages/spread-the-word.aspx): Marketing and promotional materials for sharing HealthyChildren.org resources
